title: Recording: London Town by Wings | 1977
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Peter Henderson, Mark Vigars

Wings worked on songs for their sixth studio album London Town on 16 February 1977.

The precise song details of are not known for this session and for a similar one the following day.
